news.title: AI can generate research themes. Can students defend them?
news.summary_en: Higher education has spent considerable energy debating whether students use artificial intelligence to write papers. I believe an equally consequential question deserves attention: What happens when AI helps produce the findings those papers report?

news.title: Instructional design first: AI-assisted courseware for mastery and learner agency
news.summary_en: Artificial intelligence can automate parts of the instructional process, but its greater promise is to extend the instructor’s reach rather than replace the instructor. The central question is how AI-supported environments can strengthen learner agency through individual pacing, timely feedback, and meaningful opportunities to demonstrate mastery.
